title: Mom's Chocolate Chip Cookies (Half Batch)
description: Mom’s half batch of chocolate chip cookies, with a long butter creaming step, flexible mix ins, and a 375°F / 190°C bake.
ingredients: 113 g butter, room temperature (½ cup / 1 stick)
170 g chocolate chips (1 cup), or a similar amount of M&M's or other mix ins
steps: Cream the room temperature butter with the brown and granulated sugars. Keep mixing until well creamed; Mom notes that longer is better.
Mix in the vanilla, then add the egg and mix again.
Add the flour, salt, and baking soda and mix well. Stir in the chocolate chips or other mix ins.
Preheat the oven to 375°F / 190°C. Drop roughly 20 g portions of dough, about 1 tablespoon each, onto a cookie sheet with room to spread.
notes: Transcribed from Mom's handwritten half batch recipe. The gram weights for the original cup and spoon measures are practical approximations. The notebook explicitly allows chocolate chips, M&M's, or other yummy things.
